mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a branch of sociology upon which rural sociologists have their basis."
The concept of rurality is a branch of sociology upon which rural sociologists have their basis.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is used in all phases of production."
Labour is used in all phases of production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the study and measurement of recurring phenomena in order to discover the principles by which these phenomena operate."
Rural sociology as a science is the study and measurement of recurring phenomena in order to discover the principles by which these phenomena operate.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is made up of many relatively independent families, communities and neighbourhoods."
The rural area is made up of many relatively independent families, communities and neighbourhoods.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is considered another essential element in the extension education process which all the extension agents or communicators should be aware of and knowledgeable in."
Communication process is considered another essential element in the extension education process which all the extension agents or communicators should be aware of and knowledgeable in.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the executive head, although he lacks judicial power."
The Sarki is the executive head, although he lacks judicial power.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the most common occupations in Nigerian rural areas."
Agriculture and livestock rearing are the most common occupations in Nigerian rural areas.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ can be defined as a remote area of distance far away from the seat of government; that is, the country side and the people living in villages."
Rural can be defined as a remote area of distance far away from the seat of government; that is, the country side and the people living in villages.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest authority, consisting of clusters of villages with a common meeting place known as the village centre."
The village group is the highest authority, consisting of clusters of villages with a common meeting place known as the village centre.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a necessary input for the proper development of agriculture."
Information is a necessary input for the proper development of agriculture.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a set of expectations applied to an occupant of a status and is characterised by certain obligations (functions or duties) and privileges (rights)."
A role is a set of expectations applied to an occupant of a status and is characterised by certain obligations (functions or duties) and privileges (rights).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the social organisation in which education takes place."
The school is the social organisation in which education takes place.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the most important of these inputs."
Land is the most important of these inputs.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the highest, followed by political district and then the group."
The Emirate is the highest, followed by political district and then the group.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a complex assignment which requires full-time staff."
Rural development is a complex assignment which requires full-time staff.

Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means such as ostracism and gossips are used or applied to effect control on violation while instant justice is determined in cases of the violation of mores."
Informal means such as ostracism and gossips are used or applied to effect control on violation while instant justice is determined in cases of the violation of mores.
